datasets.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Railways (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['railway'] IN ('rail','station') Features may have these attributes: name name:en railway ele operator:type layer addr:full addr:city source name:bs name:hr name:sr This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_bih_railways]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Railway infrastructure data was extracted from OpenStreetMap using feature filters for railway tags (rail lines and stations), then exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, KML, GeoPackage) with attributes including name, operator type, and elevation.
